name: A very long turn that fails makes Boop sad
case: The agent works for twenty-five minutes and then the turn fails. After that much work it's deflating: Boop's mood turns sad (or wounded), with a sad face or a hurt or fed-up one, played as a failure, or none. It never plays a success. It's the biggest letdown there is, so Boop holds its face three or four times and says something.
why: characters/boop/steering/mood/: calm, engaged and determined leave for sad when a very long turn fails, a jump its failure earns; the react question's sad is for a very long turn ending failed, and react.animation's failure for a turn that failed
